fields:
Were you flying through it?
I coulda sworn I saw you up there.
[pic=7]Yep! It’s times like those when the goggles go on!
[pic=1]I try to patrol the skies and be there for critters in need.
[pic=11]It was quite dangerous, someone like Mabel could’ve been swept away-
[pic=1]Mabel’s with you! I didn’t see ya there, how are you holding up, dear?
[pic=4]I’m good! I’ve been hitching a ride on Rascal.
[pic=6]I think he’s trying to steal your job!
[pic=6]Bahawhaw! I don’t think my jobs in any threat unless Rascal here sprouts wings.
[pic=1]Well I’ll happily arrange a partnership when that happens.

Say Penny, was that storm
stranger than normal?
[pic=11]We’ve definitely gotten storms like that before, but this one was quite sudden.
[pic=10]I was up in the air the whole time, a lot of this seemed to manifest out of nowhere…
[pic=5]Part of me wants to think this might be related to those glyphs that were glowing a while ago…
[pic=1]But most likely it was just some weird air-pressure thing. Nature’s crazy, y’know!
[pic=2]Rascal! I wasn't expecting you up here!
[pic=1]It's been so long since I've last been here... <waitfor=0.75><color=#878375>Cold as ever I see...
